glosses: The location where a person was born.

examples.text: At Scotswood, the main line crosses to the south bank of the Tyne, but an alternative route, on the north side of the river, used by a few trains, rejoins the Carlisle line beyond North Wylam, the birthplace of George Stephenson.

glosses: The location where something was created or devised.

examples.text: Coney Island was the birthplace of the hot dog.
